user.title: Connect to LeChange
user.description:
Enter your LeChange app account and choose a login method.

⚠️ This integration relies on an unofficial reverse-engineered protocol for personal use/research only. No warranty is provided and you accept all account/usage risks (see the disclaimer in the README).

password.title: Password login
password.description: Logging in as {username}; enter your LeChange app password.

sms.title: SMS code login
sms.description:
Account {username}: first get an SMS code in the **LeChange app** (SMS login / forgot-password page), then enter the 6-digit code.

(The integration also tries to send one; in practice unauthenticated sends are blocked by server anti-abuse (11010) — use the app if none arrives.)

gt4.title: Human verification (GT4 slider)

device.title: Select Device
device.description:
Select the lock device and enter the device credential pair.

**Security code**: the 8-character uppercase alphanumeric code printed next to the QR/barcode on the device label (battery compartment), also shown in App > Device settings > About, or on the box.

**Device password**: the current password after changing it in the LeChange app; if never changed it equals the security code — **leave empty**.

Used for: alarm snapshot decryption (security code) and live-stream frame decryption (device password). Stored locally only.

data.device_password: Device password (only if changed; empty = same as security code)

error.sms_needed: This account requires an SMS/two-step code; switch to the SMS-code login method.
error.captcha_needed: Anti-abuse / human verification (Geetest GT4) triggered. Complete one slider check in the **LeChange app** to unlock the account, then retry.
error.no_devices: No devices found under this account.
error.security_code_invalid: Security code should be 8 uppercase letters/digits (see device label).

abort.gt4_unavailable: GT4 slider service is not available. Restart Home Assistant and retry.
abort.gt4_timeout: GT4 slider timed out (no valid tuple received within 5 minutes).
abort.gt4_failed: GT4 verification failed. Check the log for details and retry.

init.title: Media & connection options
init.description:
Door-front snapshots use cloud stream capture (main stream by default; dual cameras combined side-by-side).
Snapshot and live preview OSD are ON by default (timestamp top-left + channel bottom-right); can be disabled. Stream requests wake the battery device — keep the interval at 60s or more.

data.device_password: Device password (empty = keep / same as security code)
data.snapshot_osd: Snapshot OSD (default on: timestamp + channel name)
data.channel_hosts: Local channel addresses (one per line: channel=IP[:port]; used first when device is on LAN, empty = cloud)
data.stream_preview_osd: Live preview OSD (default on; off = clean)
